title: Universal normalization and evaluation of source-site local Isom sheaves
statement: For two finite coefficient rings R,S and q:R→S, universal arrows A→Res A' and D→Res D' induce reduction on their actual-source local derived Isom sheaves. Canonical sourceDerivedIsoEvaluation obeys the exact square formed using localProEtaleNormalization. This statement does not involve constants, towers, covers or stalk nonemptiness. Definitions: [def-weil-pbc-source-derived-isomorphism-evaluation] and [def-weil-pbc-derived-normalization-arrows].

source.place: Tags 06YY, 07A4, 0G7E, 098K, 09BV and 0F63; compatible finite derived trivializations, step 6.

proof.text: Use the declared scalar-extension/evaluation package. Universal-arrow uniqueness identifies the scalar extensions of A,D with the specified targets. Their conjugation gives the reduction on slice Isom sheaves. The package's unit equations and scalar-evaluation equation yield the adjunct slice normalization square.

Prove comparison scalar mates agree with the package's coefficient comparisons. Prove the pro-etale localization mate square and derive it by exact-functor localization. Paste comparison and slice restriction. Conjugating the slice normalization square by the canonical source/slice equivalences gives the source square.

theorem source_normalized_iso_reduction [Finite R] [Finite S] (q : R →+* S)
    (A D : DerivedCategory (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R)))
    (A' D' : DerivedCategory (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} S)))
    (dA : A ⟶ (normalizationRestrict X.smallEtaleTopology q).obj A')
    (dD : D ⟶ (normalizationRestrict X.smallEtaleTopology q).obj D')
    (hA : StructuredArrow.IsUniversal (StructuredArrow.mk dA))
    (hD : StructuredArrow.IsUniversal (StructuredArrow.mk dD)) :
    ∃ r : derivedLocalIsomorphismSheaf A D ⟶ derivedLocalIsomorphismSheaf A' D',
      ∀ (U : X.ProEt) (ha : IsAffine U.left)
        (hw : (ProEt.topology X).IsWeaklyContractible.{u + 1} U)
        (s : ((comparisonSetUpperStar X).obj
          (derivedLocalIsomorphismSheaf A D)).obj.obj (op U)),
      (sourceDerivedIsoEvaluation X R A D U ha hw s).hom ≫
          localProEtaleNormalization U.hom q dD =
        localProEtaleNormalization U.hom q dA ≫
          (normalizationRestrict (ProEt.topology U.left) q).map
            (sourceDerivedIsoEvaluation X S A' D' U ha hw
              (((comparisonSetUpperStar X).map r).hom.app (op U) s)).hom
